findings.invariant_violated: continuity across camera cut / non-monotonic fill
findings.description: At 0:04 the jar is filled just past its halfway point with olives. After the camera cut, at 0:06, the olive level has fallen to roughly one-third of the jar's height even though olives are only ever being added. At 0:08, after pouring a portion of the steel bowl in, the jar (~45% full) is still visibly below its pre-cut 0:04 level. Comparing the 0:04 and 0:06 paused frames side by side, the olive surface sits above the jar midpoint in the first and well below it in the second; the fill fraction is not plausibly explained by the change in camera angle. The 0:06-0:08 footage appears to come from a different take with a less-filled jar.
